My eye doctor recommended I get these and they’re great! I use them 1-2 times a week.  I use one side of the pad for one eye then flip over to do the other. These soft eyelid scrubs are helpful in treating dry eye syndrome caused by clogged eyelid glands.  The “Plus” version is especially nice because you don’t have to rinse your eyes afterward, and the cleanser remains on your lids to continue to loosen the clogs.  I use them about every other day, along with artificial tears, which has kept my dry eyes under control.
I use this product to cleanse my eyelids, as I have very dry eyes.. They work very well, and do not sting or burn the eye..
Order arrived promptly and as advertised.  Will continue to order this product through Amazon.

She put me on a one wipe every other day regimen. I won't know about the bacteria part until my next exam but these worked wonders for the irritation. No more squinting or running a washcloth across my eyes for relief.

reviews.t: And okay product that works some of the time
reviews.x: My optimitrist recommended these for my dry eye problem. They are for wiping away crusted on particles or dried oils from your eyelids. The only problem is that sometimes they work, sometimes they don't. If the stuff has just been crusted on or is moist, then these will usually do the job. But if you have dried oils in your duct area, not only will these NOT clean that out, but will cause the dried bits to scrape around on your eye, irritating it more. Use judiciously and keep your expectations

They work very well but I have to use them most days, especially in the winter.  The price and delivery speed from Amazon was impressive.  Sometimes I cannot find them in the local drug store.

These scrubs are great for my dermatitis issues with eyelashes and brows.  I made the mistake of reordering the Original scrubs, not realizing you have to rinse off residue which caused additional irritation.  While this product is a little pricey it is well worth it.

claims.text: Many reviewers say these wipes help with dry eye, blepharitis, styes, and clogged eyelid glands, often on a doctor's recommendation.
Several reviewers report the wipes are gentle and soothing, without stinging or burning the eyes.
Some reviewers complain that pads arrived dried out and unusable.
A few reviewers mention cost or waste concerns, including high per-item cost and dried pads being thrown away.
One reviewer received only one box instead of the expected three-pack.
